pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + any firework rocket. Its full design is retained. Creative defaults use a white small-ball firework.

Select Watch to monitor same-owner or mutually shared workers. After the chosen continuous blocked delay, it launches a harmless firework and messages the worker’s online owners with its type, name, and cause. While blocked, alerts repeat every ten seconds.

The delay is 1–60 minutes, default five. Manual pauses and completed work do not count. Right-click launches a manual signal; applying a rocket replaces the saved design. Healing, dyes, washing, tuners, and scanners take priority.
